newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Pozmeat to issue up to 1 million new shares.
newsitem.headline: Polish Pozmeat to issue up to 1 million new shares.

text.p: Polish meat producer ZM Pozmeat SA, seeking a bourse parallel market listing, plans to issue between 500,000 and one million new shares in a public offering likely to begin on April 19, the firm said on Monday.
"This will be an issue of between 500,000 and one million shares....The subscription's beginning is tentatively planned for April 19," the company's spokesman Jacek Tucholka told Reuters.
Tucholka said the company, with capital now divided into 690,000 shares, wanted to enter the bourse in late August or early in September this year.

Pozmeat, based in the western city of Poznan and employing 1,220 people, netted 562,000 zlotys last year on sales of 133 million zlotys. It forecast its 1997 net at two million zlotys on 177 million zlotys in sales.
The company's current shareholders include the treasury, with a 17.9-percent stake, as well as Animex SA and Hormel Foods Corp., which hold 13.5 percent each.
